Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 10
Reason for Mistake: The Planner correctly identified that Blanche's father was Afonso III and that her paternal grandmother was the mother of Afonso III. However, in Step 10, the Planner incorrectly concluded that the mother of Afonso III was Dulce of Aragon. Historical records confirm that Afonso III's mother was Urraca of Castile (daughter of Alfonso IX of León and Urraca of Castile). The Planner confused the lineage: Urraca of Castile is the mother of Afonso III (Blanche's paternal grandmother), while Dulce of Aragon is the mother of Afonso II (the grandfather of Blanche). This error led to the incorrect final answer of "Dulce of Aragon" instead of the correct "Urraca of Castile."
